params.prompt: Because the insurer drafted the contract, ambiguous language is interpreted the way a reasonable insured would understand it. The reasonable expectations doctrine goes a step further in some courts: coverage the buyer reasonably expected may be honored even if fine print says otherwise. Two more principles shape health insurance. Indemnity means the policy restores a loss but should not create profit, which is why medical expense plans reimburse actual charges. Utmost good faith means both sides must deal honestly. Rosa relies on the insurer’s solvency and wording; the insurer relies on her answers.

Federal law treats insurance fraud affecting interstate commerce as a crime. Under eighteen U S C one thousand thirty-three, anyone convicted of a felony involving dishonesty or breach of trust may not work in the business of insurance without the written consent of the state insurance regulator. The same statute punishes false statements to regulators, embezzlement of insurer funds and threats against regulators or examiners, with prison terms that grow when the conduct jeopardizes an insurer’s safety. Section one thousand thirty-four lets the Attorney General seek civil penalties and injunctions. For Theo the practical rule is simple: a disqualifying conviction requires a consent letter before any insurance work.

Rosa’s disability income application reaches the home office. The underwriter must decide whether to accept her, at what price and with what conditions. The criteria are the applicant’s health history, age, occupation, income, hobbies, habits such as tobacco use and, for comprehensive medical coverage, the limits federal law now places on health-based decisions. Disability, long-term care and limited policies may still be fully underwritten. The underwriter is matching Rosa to a class of similar risks so the premium charged to each class reflects its expected claims. Fair classification protects the pool; unfair discrimination is prohibited.

Underwriting is a sorting process bounded by law. It starts with the application and producer’s report, adds medical and lifestyle information with the applicant’s notice and consent, checks for consistency and ends in a class and an offer. Along the way the insurer may not use a forbidden factor, may not treat identical risks differently and must give the Fair Credit Reporting Act and adverse underwriting notices when it declines or rates. Theo’s role is to gather complete and honest information, explain any counteroffer plainly and never promise an outcome the underwriter has not reached.

After the policy has been in force for two years, the insurer may no longer use misstatements in the application, other than fraudulent ones, to void the policy or deny a claim. It also may not deny a claim after those two years by calling a condition pre-existing unless the policy excluded it by name. This is the health insurance counterpart to the life insurance incontestability clause. Rosa’s innocent error about a past prescription cannot be raised against her in year three. Deliberate fraud remains contestable, and some policies use the stricter incontestable wording that drops even the fraud exception.

Older basic plans listed specified coverages: a hospital expense benefit for room and board, a surgical expense benefit paying by a schedule, a physician expense benefit for office visits. Each had its own limits and gaps between them. Comprehensive care, the modern major medical approach, covers the full range of hospital, surgical, physician, diagnostic and preventive services under one deductible and coinsurance structure. The Affordable Care Act requires individual and small group plans to cover ten essential health benefit categories, which pushed the market firmly toward comprehensive design.
